verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser is a law firm, but it ships its own AI product, Visalaw AI, so the axis applies. The vendor site claims the product can analyze complex documents, pull structured data from client PDFs, review an RFE and list deadlines and required items, and summarize AAO decisions while flagging trend lines. These are AI-generated insights from the user's own data inside the product. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation beyond marketing example prompts, independent or hands-on corroboration that the analysis works as claimed, evidence of proactive (unprompted) suggestions.
